message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes. Facts: a company legal representative (赵1) gives 30,0000 RMB bribe to a mayor (赵2) in his office, to secure government procurement contracts. This is bribery of public officials (行贿). The public official accepted bribe, but only defendant is Zhao1 and the company. So crime: 行贿罪 (bribery). Also possibly illegal procurement? But the act is offering bribe to obtain procurement. That's 行贿. Also maybe "非法经营"? No. So single crime: 行贿. According to correction rule: list statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So just "行贿". Output format: [罪名]行贿<eoa>. JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
